pages.text: If you are a cook, you are very lucky. Now you can prepare a lot of different food and drinks: from edible ingredients and juices, to complex, multi-level dishes that give different effects.

pages.title: Tea Kettle
pages.text: For most recipes, you need not only a workbench, but also a stove, a cooking pot, a skillet, a cutting board and a knife.
And if you're a tea drinker, then there's also a kettle.$(br)Enjoy your meal!
